description: This Java class represents the HTTP configuration for the Eclipse Ditto Gateway service, encapsulating various parameters such as hostname, port, supported JSON schema versions, security features like HTTPS enforcement and CORS, request timeouts, header configurations, and related patterns. It provides methods to create instances from a configuration object, as well as standard getters and overridden methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: GatewayHttpConfig
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating HTTP configuration for the Eclipse Ditto Gateway, including hostname, port, schema versions, security, CORS, timeout, header settings, and patterns for HTTPS redirection.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a GatewayHttpConfig instance from a Typesafe Config object.

methods.name: getCoordinatedShutdownTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured shutdown timeout duration.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the set of supported JSON schema versions.

methods.name: isRedirectToHttps
methods.description: Indicates whether redirection to HTTPS is enabled.

methods.name: getRedirectToHttpsBlocklistPattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern for URLs that should not be redirected to HTTPS.

methods.name: getActorPropsFactoryFullQualifiedClassname
methods.description: Returns the full class name for the ActorProps factory.

methods.name: getQueryParametersAsHeaders
methods.description: Returns the set of query parameters to be treated as headers.
